title: Check the loudness of the encoded file, not the limiter
chose: Measure the encoded file's true peak and re-encode lower until it is at target

over.name: Trust the limiter before encoding
over.why: AAC creates inter-sample peaks the limiter never saw.

because: The showcase film's first master measured -0.3 dBTP after encoding. Thesium must judge the master on the file the person receives.
tradeoff: Thesium may encode a master more than once.
